name: Mumbai
author: ryandicicco
description:
Mumbai

Highly-detailed map of India's financial capital and the City of Dreams, packed onto a narrow peninsula between the Arabian Sea and Thane Creek. Coverage spans the current Mumbai Metro network, from Colaba's southern tip through the western suburbs to Dahisar, plus Thane, Kalyan, and Navi Mumbai across the harbor.

Demand modeling is built on the latest authoritative data available for each source as of this writing: Census of India 2011 (population, worker counts, commute distance bands) and the 2013 Economic Census (formal-sector employment). No more recent equivalents have been published, so real growth since then, especially in Navi Mumbai and Thane, is not reflected in these numbers.

Additional Features

  • Building Collision: A buildings index is included, providing in-game collision geometry for all non-filtered buildings. Buildings have foundations ranging from -10 m to -80 m, calculated based on the building's height and footprint; the in-game foundations map layer visualizes these.
  • Water Depths: A water depth index is included, preventing tracks from being placed within the water. GEBCO bathymetric data are used where available, and a flat -5 m depth is assumed everywhere else; the in-game ocean foundations map layer visualizes these.
  • Place Labels: The map includes city, suburb, and neighborhood labels extracted from selected OSM place tags.

Methodology

    Population: WorldPop 100m gridded raster.

    Employment: OSM landuse, scaled to SHRUG/Economic Census (2013) totals.

    Base commute pairs: doubly-constrained gravity model, decay exponent calibrated against Census 2011 Table B-28 distance-band data for Maharashtra (this bbox sits entirely within Maharashtra, unlike Delhi's NCR bbox which had to borrow NCT Delhi's row for its Haryana/UP slices).

    Special demand: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport (capacity from CY2024 annual passenger throughput) and IIT Bombay, using its own officially reported enrollment.

    Consolidation: nearby low-volume commute flows spatially merged within a tiered distance threshold to keep total population count performant in-game, while preserving the variety of distinct commute destinations per origin point.

    Routing and consolidation tooling: Depot.
